name: Hero's Journey
description: Campbell's 12-stage monomyth in three acts: departure, initiation, and return. The hero leaves the ordinary world, descends through trials and ordeal, and returns transformed with an elixir.

children.title: The Ordinary World
children.synopsis: Show the hero's starting life, limitations, and unspoken need.

scenes.title: Everyday Life
scenes.synopsis: The hero exists in a familiar world, restless or unaware.

children.title: The Call to Adventure
children.synopsis: An event or messenger invites the hero across a threshold.

scenes.title: The Invitation
scenes.synopsis: A disruption puts the adventure within reach.

children.title: Refusal of the Call
children.synopsis: Fear or duty makes the hero hesitate before committing.

scenes.title: The Doubt
scenes.synopsis: The hero resists, naming why the call cannot be answered.

children.title: Meeting the Mentor
children.synopsis: A guide offers wisdom, tools, or a gift that eases the decision.

scenes.title: The Gift
scenes.synopsis: The mentor's counsel hardens the hero's resolve.

children.title: Crossing the Threshold
children.synopsis: The hero commits and leaves the ordinary world for the unknown.

scenes.title: The Leap
scenes.synopsis: The hero passes a point of no return.

children.title: Tests, Allies, and Enemies
children.synopsis: The hero is tested, makes allies, and learns the new world's rules.

scenes.title: Trials
scenes.synopsis: Small challenges map the terrain and cost of the journey.

children.title: Approach to the Inmost Cave
children.synopsis: The hero nears the site of the central ordeal, preparing.

scenes.title: Preparing
scenes.synopsis: The party gathers, plans, and steels itself.

children.title: The Ordeal
children.synopsis: A near-fatal test against death or the antagonist.

scenes.title: The Trial
scenes.synopsis: The hero faces their greatest fear or enemy.

children.title: The Reward
children.synopsis: Seizing the sword: the hero takes the treasure or knowledge won.

scenes.title: The Prize
scenes.synopsis: The hero claims what the ordeal earned.

children.title: The Road Back
children.synopsis: The hero turns toward home, pursued or irrevocably changed.

scenes.title: Turning Home
scenes.synopsis: The consequences of the ordeal chase the hero back.

children.title: The Resurrection
children.synopsis: A final test proving the hero has changed; a climactic stand.

scenes.title: The Final Ordeal
scenes.synopsis: The hero is reborn, resolving the journey's central battle.

children.title: Return with the Elixir
children.synopsis: The hero returns transformed, bearing a gift for the ordinary world.

scenes.title: Homecoming
scenes.synopsis: The hero lands the lesson, closing the once-ordinary world.
